interpretation: Physical semantic parity is independent native evidence. Difference analysis reports all changes, including RGB variation outside exact food silhouettes; projected masks do not edit or excuse shipping pixels. Existing one-step pathtrace noise is measured separately. Canonical emission/alpha/plane geometry may also change native indirect light or denoiser context; any larger residual is quantified for independent review.

nativeIndirectDiagnostic.interpretation: Food-hidden hold diagnostic isolates the unchanged body. Camera-only-food transient diagnostic disables diffuse/glossy/transmission/volume/shadow food rays without source saves; compare the source/candidate residual to unchanged shipping renders to identify noncamera food light and denoiser effects. Shipping output and source retain all original ray visibility flags.
